job.title: Azure Integration Engineer
job.description:
Senior Integration Analyst Developer

6-Month Contract | Sydney Based | Hybrid Working

We are seeking an experienced Senior Integration Analyst Developer for an initial 6-month contract with a large and complex enterprise environment.

This role is suited to a hands-on integration professional with proven experience delivering enterprise and cloud integration solutions using the Microsoft Azure integration stack. You will play a key role in designing, developing and supporting secure, scalable and maintainable integration services across a broad application landscape.

About the Role

As a Senior Integration Analyst Developer, you will collaborate with architects, technical teams and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality integration solutions that connect enterprise systems, applications and cloud services.

This position requires a strong understanding of integration architecture, API management, enterprise integration methodologies and modern cloud integration practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and support enterprise integration solutions
  • Deliver system-to-system integrations across cloud and on-premises platforms
  • Design, build and manage APIs and integration services
  • Contribute to integration architecture and technical solution design
  • Apply enterprise integration patterns and industry best practices
  • Ensure integration solutions are secure, scalable, reliable and maintainable
  • Support integration lifecycle management, governance and operational excellence
  • Work closely with technical and business stakeholders to deliver integration outcomes

Essential Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong, hands-on experience in:

  • Azure API Management (APIM)
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  • API design, development and management
  • Integration architecture and solution design
  • Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIP)
  • System-to-system integrations
  • Modern cloud integration technologies and best practices
  • Designing and implementing secure, scalable and maintainable integration solutions

Additionally, you will have:

  • Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise integration projects
  • Strong knowledge of integration methodologies and architectural principles
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities

Ideal Background

We are specifically seeking professionals who have built their careers around enterprise integration, API development, integration architecture and cloud integration delivery.

Please note: While experience in data warehousing, reporting, ETL development and analytics can be beneficial, this role is not focused on data engineering.

Applicants whose experience is primarily centred on:

  • Data engineering
  • ETL development
  • Data warehousing
  • Reporting and analytics
  • Data transformation projects

What's on Offer

  • Initial 6-month contract
  • Opportunity to work within a large and complex enterprise environment
  • Exposure to modern Azure integration technologies
  • Collaborative and high-performing technology team
  • Challenging and meaningful integration initiatives

If you're an experienced Integration Developer, Integration Specialist or Integration Architect with a strong track record of delivering enterprise integration solutions using Microsoft Azure, please reach out to Tim Moynihan on 0404 780 144.

job.title: IT Service Desk Officer - 9 months contract - $66 p/h
job.description:
IT Service Desk Officer (multiple roles)

Initial contract: until June 2027 
Onsite role | Sydney CBD location
$66 per hour including super

We are seeking an experienced IT Service Desk Officer to join a busy technology environment and provide high-quality technical support to end users.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys troubleshooting, working directly with users and delivering excellent customer service. You will be responsible for resolving service requests and incidents, supporting end-user technology and ensuring users have the tools and assistance they need to remain productive.

About the Role

As an IT Service Desk Officer, you will:

  • Provide first-level IT support for user enquiries, incidents and service requests, ensuring prompt resolution and minimal downtime.
  • Deliver support through the IT ticketing system, face-to-face walk-ups and the IT Service Desk phone line.
  • Set up, configure, support and relocate end-user technology, including:
    • Desktops and laptops
    • Monitors and peripherals
    • Printers
    • Tablets and smartphones
    • Desk phones
    • Audio-visual equipment
  • Troubleshoot network connectivity and performance issues, escalating where required.
  • Perform approved software installations and deployments.
  • Support user onboarding and offboarding in accordance with established processes.
  • Create and maintain user guides and contribute to the IT knowledge base.
  • Provide users with technical guidance, assistance and basic training where required.
  • Maintain clear and timely communication with users throughout the resolution process.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Previous experience working in an IT Service Desk or Desktop Support environment.
  • Good troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and common desktop applications, including Adobe Reader and similar applications.
  • Experience supporting end-user hardware, peripherals and mobile devices.
  • Good time management and the ability to prioritise competing requests.
  • The ability to remain calm and effective when working under pressure.
  • A proactive, customer-focused approach and a willingness to work as part of a team.

Working Environment

This is a fully onsite position and is not suitable for working from home. You will be required to work onsite to provide hands-on technical support to users and business operations.

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Service Desk professional to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical technology operations and a diverse user community.

If you have strong technical troubleshooting skills, enjoy working with people and take pride in delivering great customer service, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now with your updated resume for consideration. Tito Tealdo - titob@eitr.com.au

job.title: Senior Governance Data Analyst

  • Build strong relationships and influence stakeholders to achieve governance outcomes.

  • Strong understanding of data ownership, stewardship, metadata, data quality, and governance processes.

  • Work with senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • Play a key role in improving data governance, quality, and accountability across the organisation.

If you're passionate about data governance and driving meaningful business outcomes, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Information Protection Specialist
job.description:
Information Protection Specialist

We are seeking an experienced Information Protection Specialist to lead the establishment and maturity of enterprise information classification and protection capabilities, with a focus on Microsoft Purview, unstructured data, governance and compliance outcomes.

This role will act as the SME responsible for designing, embedding and operationalising information protection controls, ensuring they become sustainable business capabilities rather than standalone technical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Establish and mature enterprise information classification and protection capabilities.
  • Configure and optimise Microsoft Purview information protection solutions.
  • Align information protection controls with governance, risk, privacy and compliance requirements.
  • Develop reporting and insights to measure classification coverage, protection effectiveness and risk trends.
  • Support control assurance activities and audit readiness.
  • Deliver knowledge transfer and establish sustainable operating model processes.


About You

  • Proven experience implementing information protection and information classification frameworks within large or complex organisations.
  • Strong Microsoft Purview expertise, particularly sensitivity labels, auto-classification, governance and unstructured data protection.
  • Experience across data governance, risk and compliance initiatives.
  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into practical business and regulatory outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills.

Ideal candidates will demonstrate evidence-based delivery of Information Protection, Data Governance, Risk and Compliance outcomes, with experience embedding sustainable operational capabilities and driving organisational adoption.


For more information please contact Tim Moynihan on tim.moynihan@eitr.com.au
